description:
Turn one of your API keys off for good. A key can revoke itself; then the next call with it fails.
Use for: a key that leaked or is no longer needed. Calls with it are refused from then on.
Not for: finding the id of a key (list_api_keys); a replacement key (create_api_key).
Needs: an API key. Hosted sign-in cannot call this yet.
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: revoke_api_key({"keyId":"Xc81kLm2PqRs9TuvWx0Y"})
Repeat: Once this has worked, a repeat does not do it again while that result still stands: it is refused, or answers with what is already there.
Errors: already_revoked; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.

keyId.description: The id of the key, from list_api_keys.

name: revoke_api_key

isRevoked.description: The key is off for good.

title: Revoke an API key
